meta.name: epigenome-profiling
meta.description: Build comprehensive epigenomic profiles for tissues or cell types using ENCODE data. Use when the user wants to characterize chromatin states, assemble histone modification panels, create epigenomic landscapes, run ChromHMM segmentation, identify super-enhancers or bivalent domains, profile regulatory elements across a biosample, or understand epigenetic regulation in a specific biological context. Covers histone marks, chromatin accessibility, TF binding, transcription, DNA methylation, and 3D genome structure.

copy.tagline: 用ENCODE数据构建组织或细胞类型的表观基因组图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果研究表观遗传调控，需要分析ENCODE数据中的染色质状态和调控元件。
copy.tagline_en: Build comprehensive epigenomic profiles for tissues or cell types using ENCODE data

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你指定的组织或细胞类型，从 ENCODE 数据库自动收集组蛋白修饰、染色质开放性、转录因子结合、转录、DNA 甲基化和 3D 基因组结构数据，并生成完整的表观基因组图谱。
howto.when: 当你询问某个组织或细胞类型的表观基因组信息，或要求分析染色质状态、组蛋白修饰、超级增强子、双价结构域、调控元件时触发。

say.text: 帮我构建人类胰腺组织的表观基因组图谱。
分析 K562 细胞的染色质状态，使用 5 种核心组蛋白修饰。
查找 GM12878 细胞中 CTCF 和 EP300 的结合位点。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can automatically gather histone modifications, chromatin accessibility, TF binding, transcription, DNA methylation, and 3D genome structure data from ENCODE for a specified tissue or cell type, and generate a comprehensive epigenomic profile.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about epigenomic information for a tissue or cell type, or request analysis of chromatin states, histone marks, super-enhancers, bivalent domains, or regulatory elements.

say_en.text: Build an epigenomic profile for human pancreas tissue.
say_en.note: Claude will search ENCODE for relevant experiments on pancreas.

say_en.text: Analyze chromatin states in K562 cells using the 5 core histone marks.
Find CTCF and EP300 binding sites in GM12878 cells.
say_en.note: Claude will search for ChIP-seq data of these TFs.
